Sweet & Spicy Corn Bhel

What better than our local favourite bhel to accompany the pouring rain. But our version takes it a notch higher.

5 minPreparation
0 minCooking
1Servings

Ingredients

For 1 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. In a bowl, mix together the corn, onions, potatoes, 1 tablespoon chopped coriander and Kissan Chilli Tomato Sauce.
  2. Garnish with sev and the remaining coriander and serve.
